representation.app_components: Read knowledge_runtime and index_job_pump once, exact-type validate both into locals before state assignment, then assign the unchanged identities to app.state. No fallback, coercion or reconstruction.
representation.guarded_import: Extend the accepted contiguous content-free lifecycle import try with one explicit CooperativeIndexJobPump import after the accepted agent-tools, knowledge-tools and runtime imports; initialize_managers remains after the catch.
representation.initializer: After the accepted one-config knowledge build succeeds, import and call build_inert_cooperative_index_job_pump once with the exact same config object. Catch Exception as the fixed pump initializer warning and RuntimeError from None; add one index_job_pump return key only after success.
representation.shutdown: Keep knowledge close in its own first try. Immediately call the exact stored pump close in a second try. Log only the fixed pump warning on Exception, then continue to transcription stop and existing teardown.
representation.startup: Store the exact pump identity during composition and otherwise never touch it. Preserve bind_knowledge_runtime as the final startup action and add no wakeup, registration, callback or worker construction.
